captions.instagram:
How does a mobile phone work?

Your phone is a two-way radio that shouts to a tower up to a few kilometres away, proves who you are with a secret key, and hands your call from cell to cell without a click. Pull one apart in 3D, drive through a city of towers, and watch bits blur in the noise.

→ A phone is a two-way radio joined to a computer, built in thin layers.
→ A city is tiled into cells, each served by a tower with three sector antennas.
→ As you move, your phone hands over to the strongest tower without dropping the call.
→ Low bands have long waves that travel far; high bands carry more data but fade faster.
→ Each dot carries bits. When noise blurs the dots, your phone falls back to a simpler pattern.

Play with it yourself. It's free and open source: glassbox-production-fd52.up.railway.app/mobileclear (link in bio)

youtubeLong.description:
Your phone is a two-way radio that shouts to a tower up to a few kilometres away, proves who you are with a secret key, and hands your call from cell to cell without a click. Pull one apart in 3D, drive through a city of towers, and watch bits blur in the noise.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox-production-fd52.up.railway.app/e/mobileclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/mobileclear

In this video:
• A radio joined to a computer. Under the glass, the touch layer and the OLED screen, a phone is mostly battery.
• A city cut into cells. A phone sends at most about 0.2 W, so a city is covered by many towers, each with three sector antennas serving a patch called a cell.
• Bits on a wave. Phones use bands from 700 MHz (43 cm waves that reach far and pass walls) to 3.5 GHz (8.6 cm waves with more room for data), plus 26 GHz millimetre waves for 5G.
• 1G to 5G, and India's leap. Analogue voice gave way to digital GSM and texts, then the mobile web, 4G video and 5G.
• A call in five steps. Dial, then your SIM answers a random challenge with a secret key that never leaves it.
• Battery, safety and e-waste. A 5,000 mAh battery holds about 19 Wh.
